MasterChow Chilli Garlic Cooking Paste is a flavourful blend of spicy red chillies and aromatic garlic, specially crafted to bring authentic Asian flavours to your everyday meals. Simply add 1–2 teaspoons while stir-frying vegetables, paneer, tofu, chicken, seafood, or noodles for an instant burst of flavour. For best results, sauté the paste in a little oil for 30–60 seconds to release its rich aroma before adding other ingredients.
Perfect as a base for fried rice, chowmein, ramen, gravies, curries, and Indo-Chinese dishes, this versatile cooking paste also works wonderfully as a marinade for grilling, roasting, or pan-frying. It can be mixed into sauces, dips, and dressings or spread lightly in wraps, sandwiches, burgers, and rolls for an extra garlicky kick.
The balanced combination of chilli heat and garlic richness makes it ideal for both everyday cooking and special recipes. Adjust the quantity according to your preferred spice level and enjoy restaurant-style Asian flavours at home with ease and convenience.
